run_release_docs: run release_docs.py with a version number to branch wiki pages for a new Google Test release
create_wiki_branch: create versioned wiki page branches by running WikiBrancher with a dot-version string
build_version_prefix: build a version prefix string like V2_6_ from a dot-version such as 2.6
test_get_files_to_branch: test GetFilesToBranch to return a list of .wiki files that need versioned branching
update_wiki_links: update inter-wiki links in branched files to point to versioned wiki pages
